history.text: Little Rock schools integration crisis: President Dwight D. Eisenhower sends the 101st Airborne Division to Little Rock, Arkansas, and federalizes the Arkansas National Guard, ordering both to support the integration of Little Rock Central High School.
history.title: Little Rock Nine
history.description: African-American students enrolled at a previously segregated high school

culture.text: After being accused of financial improprieties, Senator Richard Nixon delivers his "Checkers speech" nationwide on television and radio, defending his actions and successfully salvaging his nomination as the Republican candidate for Vice President.
culture.title: Richard Nixon
culture.description: President of the United States from 1969 to 1974
